newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures surge by daily limit.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures surge by daily limit.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures settled sharply higher on Friday, as buying by individual investors gathered force, sparked by sharp gains in soybean futures, traders said.

The May to November contracts surged by their 500 yen per tonne daily limit at the close. The most-active contract, benchmark March, was up 270 yen at 16,790 yen. Daily volume was estimated at 88,367 lots.
The March corn futures contract on the CBOT Project A overnight trading system was quoted at $2.88-1/2 per bushel at 0855 GMT, compared with $2.87 on Thursday.
The March soybean contract on the overnight trading system was quoted at $7.90-1/2 per bushel, against $7.86 on Thursday.
